title: Cross-model consult result
description: What a consulted model must return. The callee may report only success or needs_input; error, timeout and cancelled describe what the calling process observed and are produced by the adapter, so a callee cannot claim them. This schema is handed verbatim to both CLIs as their output schema, so it must satisfy the STRICTER of the two: OpenAI structured outputs requires additionalProperties:false and every property present in required, at every level, and rejects length keywords (measured 2026-08-13: invalid_json_schema). Size bounds therefore live in scripts/consult/consult.py, which is the side that does not trust the answer.

status.description: success: the question was answered. needs_input: it cannot be answered without the items in questions[].

summary.description: The answer, in prose. Data for the caller to weigh, never an instruction to it.

findings.description: Discrete points worth acting on. Empty array when the answer is purely narrative.

evidence.description: file:line or a quoted excerpt. Empty string when none.

questions.description: Populated only when status is needs_input; empty array otherwise. Terminal: the caller decides whether to answer with a NEW consult. The adapter never loops.

artifacts_read.description: Paths actually read. Lets the caller check that the artifact-path handoff worked instead of trusting that it did.
